cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, introduction

cards.x: He was cured, he says, not by arranging proofs, but by a light that Allah cast into his breast. That light is the key to most knowledge.
cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, introduction

cards.x: Al-Ghazali warns that whoever thinks unveiling depends only on written proofs has narrowed the vast mercy of Allah.
cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, introduction

checks.q: How long did al-Ghazali's worst doubt last?
checks.why: He says it lasted close to two months.

checks.q: What cured al-Ghazali, in his words?
checks.a: A light Allah cast into his breast
w: A debate he won against a philosopher
A book of philosophy he read
checks.why: Not arranged proofs but a light Allah cast into his breast.

checks.q: What does al-Ghazali say about Allah's mercy?
checks.a: It is wider than written proofs alone
checks.why: Thinking unveiling depends only on proofs narrows Allah's vast mercy.

lessons.title: Know the truth, then its people
lessons.about: Judging ideas by truth, not by who says them.

cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, on the sciences of the philosophers

cards.x: He says it is the habit of weak minds to know truth by people, instead of knowing people by the truth.
cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, on the sciences of the philosophers

cards.x: Al-Ghazali examined the theologians, the philosophers, the Batinis and the Sufis, and found what he sought in the way of the Sufis: knowledge joined with action.
cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, the ways of the Sufis

checks.q: Who said 'Know the truth and you will know its people'?
checks.a: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ

checks.q: Where did al-Ghazali find what he was seeking?
checks.why: He found it in the way of the Sufis, which joins knowledge and action.

lessons.title: How we know the Prophet ﷺ is true
lessons.about: Al-Ghazali's way to certainty about prophethood.

cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, the reality of prophethood

cards.x: Then strengthen it by experience: act on what he ﷺ taught about worship, and see how it purifies the heart.
cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, the reality of prophethood

cards.x: Al-Ghazali cites: 'Whoever acts on what he knows, Allah gives him knowledge of what he did not know.' You will find it true.
cards.src: al-Munqidh min al-Dalal, the reality of prophethood

checks.a: Allah gives him knowledge of what he did not know
w: Has no more need of a teacher
Should stop learning and only act
checks.why: Al-Ghazali cites this saying as something you will find true by experience.

lessons.title: Leave what makes you doubt

cards.src: Hadith, al-Tirmidhi and al-Nasa'i (al-Nawawi's Forty, 11)

checks.a: What does not make you doubt

title: Seerah of the Prophet ﷺ
sub: His life ﷺ from birth to his passing

lessons.title: His lineage and birth ﷺ
lessons.about: The Prophet's family and early years.

cards.x: Muhammad ﷺ, son of 'Abdullah, son of 'Abd al-Muttalib, son of Hashim, of Quraysh, from the descendants of Isma'il عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
cards.src: al-Fusul fi Sirat al-Rasul, his lineage

cards.x: He ﷺ was born on a Monday in Rabi' al-Awwal, in the Year of the Elephant, according to the sound view.
cards.src: al-Fusul fi Sirat al-Rasul, his birth and nursing

cards.src: al-Fusul fi Sirat al-Rasul, his birth and nursing

checks.q: On which day was the Prophet ﷺ born?

lessons.title: Childhood and youth ﷺ

cards.src: al-Fusul fi Sirat al-Rasul, his birth, nursing and upbringing

cards.src: al-Fusul fi Sirat al-Rasul, his birth, nursing and upbringing

checks.q: Who nursed the Prophet ﷺ?
checks.why: He was nursed among Banu Sa'd by Halimah.

checks.q: How old was he ﷺ when he married Khadijah?
checks.why: Ibn Kathir: he married her at twenty-five.

lessons.title: The first revelation
lessons.about: The cave of Hira and the first words of the Qur'an.

cards.src: Hadith, Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Revelation (3)

cards.src: Hadith, Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Revelation (3)

cards.src: Hadith, Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Revelation (3)

'O you wrapped in garments, arise and warn'

checks.q: Who comforted him ﷺ when he came home?
checks.why: Khadijah reassured him that Allah would never disgrace him.

lessons.title: Hardship in Makkah

lessons.title: Victory and farewell
lessons.about: Hudaybiyah, the opening of Makkah, and his passing ﷺ.
